title: Titanic survivor's account of angels in a craft by the lifeboats

tellings.quote: Titanic, it described a group of angels who came in a craft land one of the lifeboats and landed on the ledge of one of the icebergs

plain: A survivor of the Titanic sinking in 1912, in a lifeboat later picked up by the rescue ship Carpathia, is said to have described "a group of angels who came in a craft", landed by one of the lifeboats and settled "on the ledge of one of the icebergs". Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, tells Michels he read this in a book on the Titanic that he does not name. He raises it as an old sighting of a craft that may fit his own accounts.
